question: Does this method improve extraction of clinical trial outcomes from medical papers?

passages.Methods: A classifier extracts trial outcomes from medical papers.
passages.Validation: On 200 held-out medical papers, F1 was 0.82 versus baseline 0.71. The split was by paper; uncertainty and external replication are not reported.

passages.Methods: The same extraction approach is applied to news articles.
passages.Validation: On 300 news articles, F1 was 0.88 versus baseline 0.80. No medical papers were tested.

passages.Methods: A proposed rule-based extractor targets clinical trial outcomes.
passages.Scope of inspected material: The complete fixture paper contains a proposal and worked example only; no measured evaluation is reported.

passages.Abstract: We propose a method for extracting clinical trial outcomes. Evaluation details are in the unavailable full text.
